input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 only permits either Party to stop the automatic one-year renewal on ninety (90) days written notice, so HDI's convenience right is already confined to the end of a term on 90 days notice (fallback-compliant), but the Company has no mid-term convenience right. Section 4.2(a) then imposes an uncapped exit fee on any Company termination (50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, payable in eight quarterly instalments), which can be many multiples of three months' Section 3.1 payments. The clause therefore fails the fallback on two material terms. We take the fallback: an express Company convenience termination on ninety (90) days written notice and a cap on the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 payments.

mappings.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.

ops.text: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon ninety (90) days written notice to HDI.
In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the aggregate payments made by the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an express Company right to terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days written notice, and capped the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 payments, consistent with our position that any early-termination fee may not exceed three months' fees.
proposal.summary: Add a Company convenience termination right on 90 days notice and cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees.
